cohort: 68 women who underwent EPH between January 2000 and December 2012 at Al-Jahra hospital, Kuwait
finding: Abnormal placentation was the most common indication for EPH, and the relative risk of EPH was 27 times higher for Cesarean deliveries compared to vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: The relative risk of emergency peripartum hysterectomy was 27 times higher for cesarean deliveries compared to vaginal deliveries.
